scope: Actual D9 core and driver, frozen protocol and completed changed-path evidence; formal queue already started under prior authorization
source_review: Builder uses original per-record D8 FT features/statistics; first four rows have zero learned feature/bias contribution. No record-crossing left/right pairs.
Full calibrated baseline remains in first fixed context window. Common-support first zero current Hann contribution is excluded; tail uses original 95 positive points.
W adjoint applies alpha to individual residuals; F adjoint applies alpha to fused residual. Both divide by the same actual T and use same weights-only lambda. Bias remains unpenalized.
Columns0/191 remain fixed to original D8 coefficients for scoring; they have no Hann training contribution.
Original D8 parameters initialize both solves separately, so F does not warm-start from fitted W.
214-Hessian cap was fixed before protocol freeze, including final true-residual capacity; all actual updates/actions and unconverged finite solutions are retained.
Six solves and original VAL only; role/iteration/lambda not selected by VAL, no encoder/head forwards or new NPY.
limitations: This is whole-record offline fixed-feature supervised loss comparison, not new causal/history inference.
Actual preconditioners differ deterministically by objective. Shared cap does not mean equal actual compute; convergence and costs must be reported.
Global 180min queue assertion does not itself reap children. Per-worker90min alarm applies; coordinator/executor must watch actual owned processes if global cap is approached, without extra budget.
No result or convergence claim yet; source review is not independent numerical audit of final coefficients/metrics.
